Final Acceptance Recommendation for Dedication of Private Roads into the County Maintenance System

The above set out roads are wholly within the unincorporated area of Lumpkin County. Connection with an existing public road has been confirmed. All plats meet the standards of the Georgia Plat Act and the standards of Lumpkin County, to include all plat provisions of the Lumpkin County Code of Ordinances, Chapter 26 - Land Development. All required information for the location of the roads and the subdivision have been properly provided. All work required by the Board of Commissioners has been completed in accordance with Lumpkin County’s development regulations.
I give m y unqualified approval for acceptance of these roads as public roads to be maintained b y Lumpkin County.
I give m y qualified approval for acceptance of these roads as publicroads. The reasons for my qualified acceptance and all comments and limitations are set out in an addendum to this memorandum.
For reasons set out in detail in the attached addendum, I recommend that the above set out roads NOT be accepted as County Roads.
